authentication: none; polite pool via mailto= or agent header; optional Metadata Plus key
cost_notes: free; Metadata Plus is commercial and was not used
free_tier: free; public pool 5 req/s (concurrency 1), polite pool 10 req/s (concurrency 3)
historical_coverage: 150M+ DOI records; strong from the 1990s, sparse before 1970
known_limitations: created/deposited are DOI-registration clocks, not publication clocks
published-online is missing for many legacy records; published-print may then be the only public clock
funder[].award[] is incomplete and inconsistently formatted, so award matching needs normalisation and still misses
resolution/relation graphs are sparse for industry-funded work
licence: metadata is openly available; each record carries its own licence[] (often CC-BY, sometimes publisher terms)
rate_limits: public pool 5 req/s / concurrency 1; polite pool 10 req/s / concurrency 3; 429 on exceed; manual blocks return 403
research_value: Authoritative DOI registry with funder and award metadata; supplies the paper-to-grant join and the DOI spine that makes cross-source de-duplication reliable across OpenAlex/Europe PMC/PubMed.
